records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: highly polished production-quality detailed pixel RPG CHARACTER TURNAROUND ATLAS, for Mertloch Chronicles, not a concept sketch. Input reference 1 is the project's established detailed Anni pixel artwork: match its crisp rich hand-pixelled rendering, face quality and warm material highlights. Input reference 2 shows the game's actual small character proportions. Create a MUCH richer finished equipped character while preserving that lovingly rough rural German comic RPG identity, not a voxel model, not block geometry, not a realistic painting. Composition: square image, strict 2 by 2 grid of exactly FOUR separate full-body images of the SAME character and EXACT SAME gear. Top left facing southeast, top right facing southwest, bottom left back three-quarter northeast, bottom right back three-quarter northwest. All stand at rest; identical height, camera 20 degrees looking slightly down, orthographic. Each figure centered in its own quadrant with generous completely transparent empty gutters and at least 40 px margin. Complete shoes, head and equipment entirely inside each quadrant. Genuine transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no letters, no border, no extra icons. Sophisticated highly detailed pixel art, visibly deliberate pixel clusters and razor-sharp contours; warm light from upper left, warm cream highlights, blue slate shadows. Designed for readability at 104 pixel body height but original atlas should show meticulous high-resolution detail. Small adult RPG proportions, expressive slightly enlarged face, about 5.5 heads tall; individual fingers and expressive eyes. Make gear visually spectacular, handcrafted, functional, with distinguishable silhouette, tiny scratches, stitching, studs and fittings. No blur, no 3D rendering, no smooth vector, no checkerboard. SUBJECT: Dosen-Dieter, 45-year-old stocky broad-shouldered jovial man, substantial beer belly, receding dark brown hair, thick brown full beard, big reddish nose. THEME: heroic village BREWMASTER and BEER. Dark teal open leather brewer vest with brass hop-leaf clasps over cream rolled-sleeve shirt, ochre leather apron with visible stitching over belly, patched denim, heavy worn leather boots. Copper brewery-pipe shoulder armor and hop vines tucked at belt, bottle-cap chainmail accents. Right hand holds imposing tankard-headed brewing hammer: carved oak haft, engraved copper-and-steel beer tankard as hammer head, foam visible contained on tankard rim. Left hand holds a round barrel-end shield with oak woodgrain, riveted iron hoops, brass tap emblem. Small amber beer bottle, folded striped towel, hanging bottle opener on belt. Gear is distinct and fully drawn in every view. Back shows a compact oak keg strapped across back, strong leather harness. Restrained amber/copper/forest green/cream palette. Humorous yet impressive, no sci-fi.
